items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Barry and I and Donald Byrd, Sonny Red, we used to hang together a lot during those days.

ctx.x: Barry Harris was around. Barry and I and Donald Byrd, Sonny Red, we used to hang together a lot during those days.
I think a couple years back I remember you getting an award -- by the way did you know John Conyers at that time? Was he on the scene?
